messages:
tess: launching a tiny canary for 'spec-hush' (speculative silence gating) on rwd-13b-4bit. route=1% mixed cluster.

marta: what's the gating rule?

tess: only speculate when next-token entropy < 0.55 AND predicted gap > 0.8 over 5 tokens. speculative budget=8 tokens. acceptance requires kl_diff < 0.035. fallback if p95 latency > 280ms.

ryan: evals? datasets and metrics?

tess: running ARC-challenge subset (150), HellaSwag (300), CodeSearch small (60), and internal chat-safety probe (200). metrics: per-example logprob delta, EM where applicable, token KL, and repetition@3.

ci-bot: deploy: rwd-13b-4bit-spechush-canary -> 1% (started 1766609995). pods=5

marta: initial telemetry after 40m?

tess: p50=120ms (baseline 132ms), p95=260ms (baseline 275ms). spec_accept_rate=3.9%. cost down ~5.5%. error rate flat at 0.14%.

ryan: quality numbers?

tess: ARC down 0.7% absolute, HellaSwag down 1.3%, CodeSearch no change. token KL +0.025 on accepted spans. Most regressions concentrated on multiple-choice style prompts.

marta: can we attach token-position histogram for accepted events? want to see if it's front-loaded.

tess: logging positions with token features (is_capitalized, is_digit, punctuation). early signal: many accepts at list separators and clause boundaries.

ryan: propose two microvariants: hush-tight (entropy<0.45 and budget=6) and hush-longonly (only allow speculate when seq_len>80). run 0.5% each for 3h.

tess: scheduled both. adding human review for 100 worst HellaSwag diffs; saving raw beams for 2% of accepted events.

ci-bot: job collect-deltas -> started 1766610020 (job id 9812).

marta: if we can bring HellaSwag within 0.5% and keep ~4-6% cost win, keep iterating. otherwise rollback.

ryan: adding degeneracy checks (repetition@5 and vocab_entropy) for accepted sequences.

tess: noted. will post a follow-up when microvariants stabilize.

marta: thanks all.
